web_alpha_cleanup_rule: alpha <= 15 becomes RGBA (0,0,0,0); alpha > 15 remains byte-identical
crop_rule: Every accepted 1448x1086 or 1447x1087 source uses the same four fixed horizontal safe windows and three fractional row boundaries. The safe windows exclude visible neighboring-frame long-weapon overflow without modifying pixels. Within each window, alpha is used only to select one padded continuous rectangle; every RGBA pixel inside that rectangle is retained.

fixed_safe_window_layout.reason: Exclude visible neighboring-frame blade overflow while retaining each target in one continuous rectangle.
